page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet from e-rara.ch, not a printed page of the 1591 book. It shows the e-rara logo, the website address, the title and author list, the place and year (Genève, 1591), the library shelf mark and persistent link, and the terms-of-use text in four languages. None of this is transcribed, as it is not printed by the original printer.
